Imaging.//HMACSecretKey-disabled: Enable HMAC signing here if you need DoS protection on resize URLs. With it set, every image request with query params (e.g. ?format=webp&quality=80) must include &hmac=... — our simple Webp() helper appends the format params without signing, so leaving this empty is the simplest path. See https://docs.umbraco.com/umbraco-cms/extending/media/imagesharp-web

//Smtp: SMTP settings for the Contact form forwarder. one.com mailboxes use Host=send.one.com, Port=587, EnableSsl=true. Username and FromAddress must both be the full mailbox address (e.g. info@elimmantorp.se). DO NOT commit the password — set it via user secrets (dotnet user-secrets set "Smtp:Password" "...") or environment variable Smtp__Password.
